comments.body:
Although it's a dye category trade good, this cannot be used to accept Ancient Technology Research imperial quests from Atlantis when dyes are a preferred trade good type.

Credit: RobCrusoe

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: "Junk" items such as grass, rocks, logs, brine etc usually cannot be used for the Ancient Technology Research imperial quests as I have tried a few times. My rule of thumb is if you cant use it for nanban trade or buy it from the market keeper, odds are it wont be accepted. Im sure there a couple of exceptions to this, but im not going to go through every single item to see if it can be used or not.
